# Origin - EU relevance fixture (one Commission report and 14 EPRS briefing notes)

Provenance and usage record for the 15 companion PDFs in this directory. The text fixture built from them is `data/processed/relevance-fixture-eu/` (notebook 14). Reuse notices below are quoted as printed in each PDF.

## State of the Digital Decade 2024, Annex 1

- **Local file** - `eu-digital-decade-2024-annex1.pdf`
- **Title** - 2030 Digital Decade, Annex 1: Competitiveness and sovereignty, people, smart greening, policy coherence and synergies (as printed on the cover; part of the report *State of the Digital Decade 2024*)
- **Publisher** - European Commission, Publications Office of the European Union, Luxembourg
- **Year** - 2024
- **Source URL** - https://ec.europa.eu/newsroom/dae/redirection/document/106688
- **Library page** - https://digital-strategy.ec.europa.eu/en/library/report-state-digital-decade-2024
- **Reuse notice as printed (legal notice, page 2)** - "The reuse policy of European Commission documents is implemented by Commission Decision 2011/833/EU of 12 December 2011 on the reuse of Commission documents (OJ L 330, 14.12.2011, p. 39). Unless otherwise noted, the reuse of this document is authorised under a Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0) licence (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). This means that reuse is allowed provided appropriate credit is given and any changes are indicated." The notice also states: "This document should not be considered as representative of the European Commission’s official position." and "© European Union, 2024."
- **Changes made** - the fixture text is a mechanical conversion of pages 4 to 75 to markdown (paragraphs joined, running elements, footnotes, chart text and captions removed); the wording is not edited
- **Fixture role** - the long document of the relevance fixture

## Purpose

Retained solely for calibration and test-fixture construction in the `docdistance` project - text conversion, statement segmentation and relevance-fixture material. Not redistributed beyond what the licence allows, not used for model training, and not part of any published artifact. All rights remain with the original publisher.
